name: Post hoc unbounded-ridge necessary-condition audit
scope: K=100, both archived datasets, seeds 11,22,33,44,55; first seven original upper-width endpoints; no model fitting or new data
question: How much zero certificate coverage is excluded by a large-penalty strict competing-class limit, and how much remains unresolved by this diagnostic?
endpoint_formula: row-normalized r_sigma @ (Y_C+V_sigma+P_sigma) equals positive scaling of h_sigma^T H_sigma^T Y
primary_obstruction: max competing limit score minus nearest-class limit score > 1e-10*(1+abs(nearest_score)+abs(competing_score))
ties: All scores inside guard are unresolved; no tied limit is interpreted as impossibility. Report unguarded argmax for descriptive agreement only.
finite_witness: For each floor and endpoint, union all archived fitted predictions with sigma<=t and finite lambda>=floor; disagreement excludes that query rectangle.
partition: certified; excluded by guarded limit at any evaluated sigma<=t or archived finite witness; unresolved. Check certified and excluded disjoint. Grid absence of obstruction supplies no uniform guarantee.
counts_units: One query per dataset/seed/upper-width/floor rectangle. Percentages within each group, n=4027 or 10000. Summary unweighted mean and sample SD across five seeds. No independent-query or grid replication inference.
inputs: Archived indices, prototype labels, V/P terms and all prediction probes; original raw images for query geometry; archived separate evaluation labels for descriptive accuracy only.
no_selection: All seeds and original widths reported. No optimizing widths against labels.
staged_extension: If stage 1 shows unresolved mass at first failing scaled endpoint >=10% in either dataset mean, extend to archived 67-width range at K100 using recomputed H^T Y only and archived masks. This localizes whether observed loss of coverage is forced near frontier. Stop after K100; no fit and no K50/K200 expansion.
cost_control: Single-thread BLAS; stage1 reuse V/P (7); stage2 at most 670 feature evaluations of 20000x100 and 670 matrix products to 10 classes; no factorization.
provenance: Existing analyses and their test labels already inspected; this is explicitly post hoc, not preregistered.
